cover: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an attention-grabbing minimalist flat vector editorial cover for a thoughtful technical article. Wide landscape aspect 2.4:1. Background warm off-white, shapes deep navy, one vivid coral accent. On the right, five oversized plain domino slabs in a dynamic sequence: the first two have tipped over, the third is caught partway because a clear gap separates it from the last two upright slabs. No numeric dots or lettering on slabs. The visual metaphor is a process that works once but does not continue reliably. Beautifully composed geometric silhouettes with slight isometric perspective but no photoreal material or shading, crisp graphic edges, maximum negative space. On left large sophisticated sans-serif headline exact text 'Passing once is not the same as being reliable'. Small label 'AI EVALS'. Keep the typography elegant and restrained, not an all-caps shout. Distinctive modern magazine art direction, title readable at thumbnail size. No check marks, X marks, result cards, graph, dashboard, robot, brain, circuitry, gradients, texture, logo or watermark. Main elements safely inset for blog-header crop.
